title: Grayton Beach "All Decked Out" 64 Hotz Avenue
h1: Grayton Beach "All Decked Out" 64 Hotz Avenue
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf-front- New decor and furnishings for 2025- Private pool *Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $65 per day**- Close proximity to local dining establishments - fantastic food and lively atmosphere - Free WiFi- Pool table - Elevator- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 6 Adult Bikes- 5 dedicated parking spots- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (Mar 1-Oct 31)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience a luxurious and lively getaway when you book your stay in this incredible home! 64 Hotz Avenue is "All Decked Out" and features 6 beds, 5.5 baths, and wonderful accommodations for 16 guests. Located just steps from Chiringo and AJ's - two of the best dining spots in Grayton Beach - and with easy access to the local beach tailgate access point, this home is a perfect vacation destination for a large group of your closest adult friends!The main living level on the fourth floor ensures breathtaking Emerald Coast views throughout this spacious floor plan. Serene seafoam walls and natural wood floors accent the bright and airy feel. The chef's kitchen features bright white cabinetry, marble countertops, a premium gas range, top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, and a large center island - a perfect spot for cocktails and appetizers while the cooks are at work. A large dining table and extra seats at the breakfast bar ensure plenty of room for everyone at mealtime. The relaxing living room boasts plush furnishings and a mounted flat-screen television. The first floor features a pool table and an additional living room with a full bath. This home features a variety of beautiful bedrooms. The second floor showcases a primary suite with a king bed and private bathroom; a king bed guest room with access to a shared bathroom; and a spacious bunk room with a twin-over-twin bunk bed, a twin-over-full bunk bed with a twin trundle, and access to the shared bathroom. Three bedrooms await on the third floor, including two guest rooms with a king bed each and access to the shared bathroom, a primary suite with a king bed and a private bathroom with a large shower and a soaking tub."All Decked Out" offers 3 expansive, gulf-facing decks, an elevator, complimentary daily beach setup with 2 chairs and 1 umbrella, 6 adult beach cruiser bikes, and a custom a 6-seater Low-Speed Vehicle. Entertainment options abound, between the game room on the first floor, a sparkling private pool (which can be heated seasonally), and the close proximity to the best spots in Grayton Beach, including Chiringo, AJ's, and beloved local favorite, The Red Bar.Gather your group and enjoy the getaway you've all been dreaming of!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Bunk Room: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed and Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed with Twin Trundle, Shared Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubParties, weddings or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing by the management company. Fees apply.*Please note that there is active construction near this home.
